text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum with a 1.9% gain versus Ethereum's 1.0%, signaling modest strength in the largest asset despite persistent fear conditions. The Fear & Greed index sits at extreme fear with minimal weekly change, suggesting traders remain cautious even as prices edge higher and Bitcoin dominance holds firm at 56.4%. Total volume at $54B is moderate, indicating this recovery lacks the conviction needed to shift sentiment meaningfully from fear to neutral territory.
